name: Psyduck
normal: yellow body, cream beak and belly
source: Game8/Gen IV web text: shiny is blue/turquoise instead of yellow
note: Narrow yellow window should leave the pale beak.

name: Koffing
normal: purple-grey body, cream face skull marking

name: Kangaskhan
normal: warm brown body, yellow belly, dark red-brown spots
shiny: grey-taupe body (nearly neutral), pale yellow belly, spots a duller red
source: pokemondb.net/sprites/<name> (HOME normal vs shiny sprites, per-pixel OKLCh comparison; Bulbapedia 403)
note: Re-measured. Body (h50-60, 57%, L0.58, C0.077) goes to C0.019, L0.66, nearly neutral. Belly (h90-110, 29%) keeps its hue and drops chroma by about 0.68. The old belly rule shifted hue +6, which the data does not show; now a pure chroma drop. Red-brown spots (h20-25, 2.5%) go to h11, C0.068, L +0.1 (rule added). Body window narrowed to 45-65. Sim error 0.0196 -> 0.0117.

name: Ledian
normal: vivid red body and feet, yellow underside, black spots
shiny: orange-gold body and feet, lime-yellow underside, black spots
desc: red turns orange-gold, yellow underside shifts slightly greener
source: pokemondb.net/sprites/<name> (HOME normal vs shiny sprites, per-pixel OKLCh comparison; Bulbapedia 403)
note: Re-measured. Red (h15-25, 36%, L0.60, C0.239) goes to h67-69, L0.75, C0.148. Underside yellow is two groups: h80-85 (12%) goes to h111 (+27), h90-100 (6%) to h109 (+15), so two rules replace the single 90>110 one. Blue eyes (h245) and black spots unchanged. Sim error 0.0296 -> 0.0202.

name: Cleffa
normal: light pink body, brown ear tips
shiny: slightly cooler/paler pink body, green ear tips
desc: brown ear tips turn green; body stays pink with a slightly cooler tint
source: pokemondb.net/sprites/<name> (HOME normal vs shiny sprites, per-pixel OKLCh comparison; Bulbapedia 403)
note: Re-measured. Body (h25-35, 75%, C0.065) goes to h353, C0.049. Ear tips (h65-75, 22%, L0.40, C0.056) go to h154, L0.64, C0.08; light scale raised from 1.5 to 1.6 and the window narrowed to 61-77. Sim error 0.0213 -> 0.0101.

name: Ursaring
shiny: vivid lime-green body, paler cream-yellow ring
source: pokemondb.net/sprites/<name> (HOME normal vs shiny sprites, per-pixel OKLCh comparison; Bulbapedia 403)
note: Re-measured. Body (h45-55, 77%, L0.65, C0.072) goes to h132, L0.74, C0.20. Belly ring (h90-110, 13%, C0.15-0.18) keeps its hue (96-108) and drops chroma to 0.09; the old 95>103 rule shifted hue +8 and the old 70>125 rule with 15 width leaked onto the ring, so a pure chroma rule 99>99 and a narrow 68>127 were used. Sim error 0.0194 -> 0.0134.

name: Tyranitar
normal: green armored body, tan belly, dark spikes
note: Belly is tan (hue ~80), outside the green window.

name: Swalot
normal: purple body, yellow-orange spots and mouth detail, black patches
shiny: periwinkle blue body, orange-yellow spots, black patches turn dark grey
desc: purple body turns blue, yellow spots shift toward orange
source: pokemondb.net/sprites/<name> (HOME normal vs shiny sprites, per-pixel OKLCh comparison; Bulbapedia 403)
note: Re-measured. Body (h280-290, 89%, L0.66, C0.112) goes to h262, L0.75, C0.098. Yellow spots (h87-110, 2.5%) go to h62-72, L x0.9, C x0.8. Black patches (L0.03-0.07, 7%) lighten to L0.4 grey in the shiny; the old note said they stay dark, but grey rules cannot lighten, so not modeled. Sim error 0.0449 -> 0.0375.

name: Trapinch
shiny: pale grey-teal body (low chroma, hue ~170), slightly lighter jaws
desc: orange body drains to pale teal-grey
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-measured both HOME sprites. Body hue 45-50 (3,700 px, C 0.158) goes to hue 171, C x0.33, L x0.96; jaw hue 60-80 goes to hue 163-167, C x0.5, L x1.08-1.11. A single 55>170 rule left a 10-20 degree hue error on both parts, so it is now split: body 48>171 and jaw 68>165. Small grey patch (eyes) turns green in shiny; not ruled.

name: Tropius
normal: green body, brown neck leaves, yellow fruit
shiny: lighter yellow-green body, brown leaves nudged yellower and brighter
desc: green body lightens toward lime; brown leaves go golden
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-measured. Body is hue 135-140 only (5,200 px, L 0.65, C 0.173) to hue 120, L 0.80, C 0.147: source center moved 130->137 so the rule shifts by -17 instead of -10. Brown leaves hue 60-70 (2,300 px) to hue 86-89, C x1.23, L x1.12; window narrowed to 63+-10 so the yellow fruit (hue 85-105, stays ~90-100) is no longer pushed by the feather.

name: Swampert
normal: blue body and fin, orange cheeks/fingers, cream belly
shiny: purple-pink body and fin (hue ~320), orange parts become pale peach, belly slightly lavender
desc: blue turns purple-magenta; orange cheeks go pale peach
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-verified on both HOME sprites: blue body hue 205-240 (72%) to hue 313-337 (center 320), C x1.0-1.2; orange hue 55-80 stays hue ~60 but C x0.54, L x1.05 (pale peach); near-grey belly L 0.7-0.85 tints to hue 291 at C 0.033. Rules unchanged.

name: Shinx
normal: light blue body, yellow ear/tail stars, black underparts
shiny: yellow body (hue ~95), ear/tail stars become orange, black stays
desc: blue body turns yellow; yellow stars turn orange
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-verified on both HOME sprites: blue hue 205-240 (67%, C 0.079) to hue 92-100, C x1.9-2.2, L x1.05; yellow hue 85-120 (17%) to hue 58-80, L x0.88, C x0.9. Black greys unchanged. Rules use original hue so they do not chain.

name: Gliscor
normal: muted purple body, red eyes/crest, dark grey underside
shiny: lighter blue-grey body (hue ~246), red parts become yellow-green
desc: purple body turns blue; red accents turn yellow
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-measured: body hue 280-300 (50%, C 0.046) to hue 246, C x1.23, L x1.19; red hue 0-30 (6%, center ~22) to hue 90-116, C x0.5-0.57, L x1.4. Red window widened to 24+-26 so the hue 0-15 reds are caught too. Body chroma ~0.046 is near the 0.04 min_c cutoff, so some body texels may be skipped; dark grey (38%) stays dark.

name: Tepig
normal: orange-red body, black snout/feet, cream face
shiny: pale yellow body (hue ~100, brighter), red parts pinker, black parts become brown
desc: orange turns pale yellow; black turns warm brown
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-measured: orange hue 45-70 (97% of orange area) to hue 89-107, L x1.22-1.25; red hue 20-30 to hue 3-13, L x1.16; dark greys L<0.5 (33%) become hue 31 brown at chroma 0.078-0.103. Orange window narrowed to 58+-20 (38-78) so the cream-yellow face (hue 90-105, which stays) is not shifted by the feather. Cream face stays.

name: Drilbur
normal: blue-grey body with grey/white lower half, red nose tip
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-verified on both HOME sprites: body hue 270 (21%, L 0.60, C 0.119) to hue 357, C x0.75, L x1.13; greys only drift slightly (C under 0.03), so no grey rule. Small red nose (2%) turns blue-grey; too small to rule.

name: Scolipede
normal: red-orange body, pink/magenta segments, grey plates
shiny: red-orange body slightly lighter, segments turn teal-cyan (hue ~195), greys tint teal
desc: magenta segments turn teal; body stays red, lighter
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-measured: red body hue 0-25 (57%, L 0.49) to hue ~24, L x1.17, C x0.88; pink hue 340-360 (13%) to hue 193, L x1.2, C x0.75-0.85; greys L 0.3-0.7 (29%) tint to hue 166 at C 0.031-0.036. Grey range widened from 0.35-0.65 to 0.3-0.7 so the measured grey bands are fully covered. Windows are tight (10 and 14) because the pink and red hues touch near 355-5.

name: Crustle
shiny: greyer shell (chroma down ~40%), body turns yellow-green (hue ~120)
desc: shell desaturates to grey; body turns green-yellow
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-measured: shell hue 60-70 (4,000 px, C 0.065, L 0.60) keeps its hue/lightness but chroma drops to C 0.040 (x0.62, so 74% of shell goes near-grey); body hue 40-50 (13%, C 0.14) to hue 117, L x1.09, C x0.85. The old body rule (47+-10 with 12 feather) reached hue 69 and would have partly recolored the main shell hue 65; body window is now 47+-8 and listed first, shell 66+-12 second so the shell wins any overlap.

name: Heliolisk
normal: yellow body and frill, orange frill accents, grey underside
shiny: orange-red body and frill (hue ~30, darker), orange accents become yellow
desc: yellow turns orange-red; orange accents turn yellow
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-verified on both HOME sprites: yellow hue 85-110 (47%, L 0.76-0.94) to hue 28-35, L x0.74-0.80, C ~x1.0; orange hue 45-60 (14%) to hue 89-102, L x1.26, C x0.8. Greys unchanged. Rules unchanged.

name: Rockruff
normal: tan-brown body, white ruff, blue eyes
shiny: blue-grey body (hue ~236), darker brown shifted slightly, eyes green
desc: tan body turns blue-grey; blue eyes turn green
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-measured: tan hue 45-55 (1,700 px, C 0.045, L 0.73) to hue 236, C x1.27, L x1.02; darker brown hue 30-40 (640 px, L 0.47) to hue 43, L x1.16; blue eyes hue 240-250 to hue 114, C x1.4. The old tan window (50+-20) overlapped the brown (30-45), so the brown texels would have turned blue-grey; brown is now 34+-7 (listed first) and tan 51+-9. Body chroma is only ~0.045, right at the 0.04 min_c cutoff, so some tan texels may be missed.
